summary: ECARX Holdings Inc., a foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K on September 28, 2026, incorporating its interim report for the six months ended June 30, 2026, by reference into its existing F-1/F-3 registration statements. The filing, signed by CFO Dylan D. Jeng, is an ordinary semi-annual financial report containing balance sheet, income statement and segment data, with no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor or structural mechanics disclosed. No special-situation event exists; the filing is routine periodic disclosure only, with no risk-arb angle to monitor.
